services.title: Deep Tissue
services.description: Targeted pressure for chronic tension to relieve muscle pain and stiffness. This massage focuses on the deepest layers of muscle tissue, tendons, and fascia.

services.title: Aromatherapy
services.description: Essential oils meet therapeutic touch. Enjoy a relaxing massage combined with the use of highly concentrated plant oils to improve both physical and emotional well-being.

services.title: Hot Stone
services.short_description: Heated stones for deep muscle relief
services.description: Heated stones are placed on specific parts of your body to relax and ease tense muscles and damaged soft tissues, allowing for deeper manipulation.

services.title: Sports Therapy
services.description: Designed for athletes and highly active people, engaging in intense physical activity. It helps prevent injury, improve flexibility, and enhance athletic performance.

services.title: Swedish
services.description: A classic full-body relaxation massage using gentle, flowing strokes to decrease muscle toxins, improve circulation, and ease tension. Perfect for first-timers.

services.title: Couples
services.description: Share a relaxing experience with a partner or friend. Enjoy a therapeutic massage side-by-side in the same room with continuous, synchronized tension relief.

therapist_main: My passion is helping you achieve a pain-free, relaxed lifestyle through dedicated treatment plans tailored to your specific needs. I specialize in deep tissue and therapeutic techniques.
about_text:
At RTM, I believe that true wellness comes from a balanced approach to body and mind. Located in Edmonton's vibrant downtown, my studio offers a peaceful escape from the everyday.

As a registered massage therapist, I combine traditional techniques with modern approaches to deliver results-driven treatments. Whether you're dealing with chronic pain, recovering from an injury, or simply need to unwind — I've got you covered.
